title: Bounded rank-directed jet completion with integral factor witnesses
status_note: Draft only: no runner, frozen protocol, resource estimate, funding, Cairn lease, or execution is in place. Freeze coefficient and denominator budgets and implement an independently checkable witness format before considering readiness.
question: For L=4 and 8, can a degree-bounded rational matrix H yield lower precision-adjusted crossing-mode cost than the original kernel and flattening control while admitting exact integral factorization witnesses at every retained node?
decision_value: A valid witness at a frozen size and precision would show whether rank-directed completion merits a larger uniform-construction study; rejection or no candidate under the fixed coefficient and denominator budgets would quantify this search domain's obstruction. Neither outcome alone establishes an asymptotic improvement, a DLP solver, or a runtime gain.
